title: Aaron Glenn: Frank Reich is doing a good job as offensive coordinator

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn: Frank Reich is doing a good job as offensive coordinator
sources.description: The Jets finished 29th in points scored during Aaron Glenn's first season as their head coach, so it was not a great surprise that they made the choice to fire offensive coordinator Tanner Engstrand at the end of the campaign.
